page.layout: One column of running text, a Hebrew-Latin lexicon. Each entry is a paragraph opening with a Hebrew headword, the headword in larger type. Running head at top centre. Printed page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: tuit, Instituit, Restituit: Stabilivit, Distinuit: Præter. העמיד Constituit, 2.Par.19.8. העמדתה Constituisti, Psal. 30.8. &c. Hoph. Partic. ממעמד Distentus erat, Distinebatur, 1.Reg.22.35. ואין מעמד Et non est stabilitum, stabile, Psal.68.3. Aben Esra vult esse Nomen, Status, Standi locus. Futur. יעמד sistitor, Lev.16.10.
עמוד m. Columna, quasi Statuam vel Statumen dicas, Exod.13.22. Plur. עמודים 1.Reg.7.41. Construct. עמדי החצר Columna atrii, Exod.38.17. Aff. עמודיו Columnas ejus, Exod.36.38.
עמדי f. Constitutio: Aff. עמדתו Constitutionem suam, Mich.1. v.11.
עמדי m. Mecum, Psal.23.4. quasi Apud me Stans; nec reperitur cum aliis Affixis.
מעמד m. Status, Statio, Constitutio: Constr. ומעמד Et statum, 1.Reg.10.5. Aff. ומעמדך Et de statione tua, Jesa. 22.v.19. מעמדם Constitutio eorum, 1.Par.23.28.
עמל Laboravit, Elaboravit: Molestiam attulit vel Intulit. Præter. שלא עמל-בו In quo non laboravit, Eccles.2.21. &c.
עמל m. Laboriofus, Ærumnosus, Molestus, Job.20. v.22. Plural. להלמות עמלים Ad malleum laborantium, Jud.5.26.
עמל m. Labor, Molestia, Perversitas, Numer.23.21. Constr. עמל האדם Labor hominis, Eccl.6.7. fœm. est, Eccl.10.15. Aff. עמלי Labor ejus, Psal.7.17. עמלנו Laborem nostrum, Deut.26.7.
עמם Texit, Operuit, Abscondit: Obscuravit ex Chaldaica lingua ufu. Præterit: עממו Abscondebant eam, Ezech.31.8. עממוך Absconderunt te, Ezech.28.3. Hoph. Futur. יעם והב Obscuratur autrum, Thren.4.1.
